mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_stop (activity_id, seq, name, place_id, longitude, latitude, start_time, end_time, transport_mode, note) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{seq}, #{name}, #{placeId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{transportMode}, #{note})
mapper.sql: SELECT s.activity_id AS activityId, s.seq, s.name, s.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS placeName, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.transport_mode AS transportMode, s.note FROM activity_stop s LEFT JOIN place p ON p.id = s.place_id
mapper.select: WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY s.seq ASC
